item: LDT-side zombie/residual-process audit for the Tier-1/Tier-2 facet-bake / cortex-api chain, plus decision-doc item 8 (rebake/publish trigger verification): nodeFacetBakeTier1.ts, nodeFacetBakeTier2.ts, and their 5 CLI wrappers under artifacts/api-server/src/. See _decisions/2026-09-06_boundary_envelope_atom_program_scope.md, program items 2/3/8 and the LDT staffing note.
checkpoint: DONE (investigation only, run via a reviewed sub-agent). No decommission, retirement, redeploy, or code change performed -- classification and evidence only.
method: For each of the 5 npm-scripted CLIs: git log --follow + git log -S<npm-script-name> on artifacts/api-server/package.json and the CLI files themselves (real touch history, not guessed). Cross-referenced against .github/workflows/*.yml (grepped for the script/file names -- none found wiring any of them into CI or deploy). Queried the real GCP project (legacy-design-tools-prod, confirmed as the actual serving project because its county-ledger-heartbeat scheduler target URL is the live cortex-api service) via gcloud scheduler jobs list/describe, gcloud run jobs list/describe, and gcloud secrets list -- real deployed state, not assumed. Traced the actual production serve path (brokerageNodeFacets.ts, brokeragePlaceBuildableEnvelope.ts) to see what a baked row's facets are actually used for today, not what the bake's own docstring claims. A background sub-agent independently searched doc_repo (90_runbooks, _inbox, _decisions, _catalog) for any documented cadence/runbook step; findings cross-checked against the code-level and gcloud-level evidence below.

confirmed_live_and_current.evidence: Actively maintained (last real commit 2026-08-31, #578-adjacent work). Base facts / land-use / zoning / acreage are real, still-served facets. Documented as a required manual onboarding step: doc_repo/90_runbooks/factory_2_jurisdiction_depth.md Step Z7 gives the verbatim command (pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server node-facet-bake-tier1 -- --county=48021) and cites a real Elgin run (doc_repo/_inbox/2026-08-04_elgin_step1_tier1_rebake.md, 3,798 stamped parcels -> 3,762 Tier-1 facets, gap fully explained). Real per-county runs on record for a DFW backfill campaign (Tarrant, Rockwall, Parker, Kaufman, Johnson, Ellis, Denton, Dallas, Collin, 2026-08-04/06 dry-run+apply log pairs). Event-triggered (per-county onboarding), never a recurring cron -- none was ever claimed.
confirmed_live_and_current.envelopeCaveat: Its envelope output is a permanent honest-decline stub only. lib/nodeFacetBakeTier1.ts's own header calls this the 'Anti-zombie cut (Master WDLL 3.7 / I-A)': computeTier1Envelope always returns status='declined' (declineReason 'atom_path_pending' or 'no-zoning-stamp'), never a real derived envelope. nodeFacetTier1Assemble.ts hardcodes facetCoverage.envelope: false with the comment 'Tier-1 never counts envelope as product coverage. Product envelope is the atom-chain path only.' The serve route additionally runs stripZombieEnvelopeFromFacets() on every response. Live and current, envelope slot intentionally inert by design, not a live problem.

confirmed_live_and_current.evidence: CONFIRMED: the production buildable-envelope route (brokeragePlaceBuildableEnvelope.ts, fetchPropertyAtomChain) fetches the property atom chain LIVE, per-request, from the retrieval-api -- it does NOT read from a Tier1/Tier2 baked snapshot for envelope truth. Traced imports directly, not inferred from naming. As of this checkout's HEAD (5303c11b, 2026-09-06, 'fix(buildable-envelope): reconcile against the atom chain; retire silent road-class default') this was tightened further same-day: the route now reconciles the live-derived geometry's area against the atom's own {kind, areaSqFt} outcome via reconcileAtomEnvelope.ts, and derive.ts no longer silently defaults to roadClassSetbackTableForJurisdiction() (item 3). Both cite this decision doc's items 2 and 3 in the commit body. Net: baking does NOT need to be re-triggered for the live envelope route to see a freshly-minted atom -- it already reads it live; items 2/3 are closed as of this commit (the decision doc's own table predates it).

Real, actively maintained (last commit 2026-09-01, #578). The F-06 publish-lane bake reading conformant-v1 hauska_mcp atoms. Requires HAUSKA_MCP_DATABASE_URL, which is NOT among this GCP project's Secret Manager secrets (gcloud secrets list on legacy-design-tools-prod: ATOMS_DATABASE_URL, DEPLOYMENT_DATABASE_URL, DEPLOYMENT_DATABASE_URL_DIRECT, EMPRESSA_DATABASE_URL, FACTORY_DATABASE_URL, FACTORY_DATABASE_URL_RO, HAUSKA_MCP_KEY, STAGING_ATOMS_DATABASE_URL, STAGING_DEPLOYMENT_DATABASE_URL, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY -- no HAUSKA_MCP_DATABASE_URL) -- structurally cannot run standalone from this project's own deploy tooling. A code comment in nodeFacetTier1Assemble.ts names the real consumer: hauska-factory's own esbuild publish bundle (scripts/build-publish-bake-clis.mjs) bundles and runs this CLI from that repo's environment. Real, cross-repo consumer -- NOT independently re-verified here (different lane's checkout, covered by tonight's separate factory audit); flagging rather than assuming.

Real code, trivially cheap, and was a STUB from its very first commit (ab8a237b, 2026-07-21), not a retired implementation. Never performs a live FEMA/OSM fetch; copies presence off already-published Tier-1 rows and stamps a literal {flood: null, envelope: null, source: 'conformant-v1-tier2-stub'}. Unlike its non-conformant sibling below, no wasted live-fetch cost and needs no ruling -- already matches the current retired-flood/retired-envelope reality, coincidentally, since inception.

real_but_unclear_cadence_needs_ruling.evidence: Real, single-purpose, necessary code (Wave R, commits 1f53171e/65f924e8, 2026-09-01) that patches cad_property dollar/age fields onto EXISTING place_layer_snapshots rows -- explicitly does not rebuild zoning/envelope/land-use. Necessary because the legacy Tier-1 bake (nodeFacetBakeTier1Cli.ts's buildTier1Payload) hardcodes cadRoll: cadRollFromClaim({taxYear:null, marketValue:null, ...}) -- every legacy Tier-1 bake writes cadRoll as ALL NULLS at bake time by design, deferring dollar/age population entirely to this separate patch pass. CONFIRMED currently open, not hypothetical: doc_repo/_inbox/2026-09-02_p106_rail_census.md (4 days before this audit) states directly: 'the tier-1 bake's cadRoll block does not [carry values]: the node-facet-patch-cad-roll CLI has not run for these counties' -- across all 6 CTX counties, leaving 4 dollar/age rails baked at zero. The onboarding runbook (90_runbooks/factory_2_jurisdiction_depth.md) documents Step Z7 (Tier-1 bake) as required but has NO corresponding step for this patch -- a fresh county onboarded via the documented runbook today would silently reproduce the exact same gap already on record. Same finding class as the sibling factory audit's factory-bake-migrate 'real rebuild-story gap' -- not a zombie, a real missing/undocumented step needing a ruling on whether to fold it into Step Z7 or track it as its own per-county step.

genuine_zombies_safe_to_consider_retirin.evidence: Strongest zombie candidate found. Performs REAL, costly live work every run: one FEMA NFHL point-query per 0.005-degree tile (own docstring: 'Overpass ~5s on a clean 200, 504s ~50% of the time; FEMA ~0.5-1s') plus optional OSM Overpass queries when --enable-roads is passed, writing real rows to place_layer_snapshots under node-facets:tier2. BUT both facets it authors are dead at the serve path: (1) envelope -- same anti-zombie retirement as Tier-1 (hardcoded null via Tier2Overlay's envelope:null type field, stripped at extractTier2Overlay); (2) flood -- explicitly and completely retired at the read path by lane SS-W16 (2026-08-19, commit 93511895 'stop serving the retired tier2 flood determination'), enforced by a dedicated, self-testing CI gate (.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml job ss-w16-tier2-flood-not-served) asserting brokerageNodeFacets.ts's disposeTier2Flood() can ONLY ever refuse producer 'fema:nfhl-flood-zone' -- the exact adapterKey this bake's own Tier2FloodFacet.provenance stamps. The route's own comment states measured accuracy: correct in 0 of 5,714 adjudicated cases (median 227m / max 366m off the real parcel), why it was retired. No CI workflow references this script. No Cloud Scheduler job in legacy-design-tools-prod targets it (only scheduler job in the project: county-ledger-heartbeat, */10 * * * *, unrelated). No Cloud Run Job resource runs it (only Cloud Run Job in the project: pe-overpass-tip-smoke, also unrelated -- and itself notable: all 3 of its own executions failed, last run 2026-07-23, never since -- adjacent, out-of-scope observation, not chased further). No doc_repo runbook documents running this script (unlike Tier-1's Step Z7). Last real code touch (f4784cc5, 2026-07-25) predates the SS-W16 flood retirement (2026-08-19) by nearly a month -- nobody has revisited the CLI since to gate off the now-fully-wasted live-fetch cost. The only surviving product value from a Tier-2 row today is its bare bakedAt/snapshotAt timestamp; both real facets are unconditionally refused.
genuine_zombies_safe_to_consider_retirin.recommendation: Needs an explicit operator ruling: either retire/gate off this bake command entirely (its FEMA/OSM cost buys nothing served today), or, if a future 'road leg' or a new flood surface is planned to revive it, document that plan so it isn't confused with dead code meanwhile. Left as a ruling item, not decommissioned.

additionalObservations.antiZombieAsymmetry: The envelope retirement (Master WDLL 3.7 / I-A, spanning derive.ts, nodeFacetBakeTier1.ts, nodeFacetBakeTier2.ts, nodeFacetTier1Assemble.ts, and brokerageNodeFacets.ts's stripZombieEnvelopeFromFacets) is enforced only by hardcoded type/value constraints and code comments -- no dedicated CI regression gate analogous to ss-w16-tier2-flood-not-served's self-testing grep gate for flood. Not a defect, a real difference in how thoroughly each retirement is guarded against silent regression; worth noting if this program wants parity.
additionalObservations.adjacentInstrument: nodeFacetTier1ShapeDiffCli.ts (not one of the 5 assigned CLIs) is a real, still-current read-only diagnostic (OPS-19 A-025) verifying shape parity between the legacy and conformant Tier-1 bakes. No npm script wraps it; run directly via tsx. Not a zombie, no action needed -- mentioned only because it turned up while tracing the bake path.

relatedPr: empressaioemail-tech/legacy-design-tools#626 (fix/envelope-atom-shared-reader) -- items 2 and 3 of the same decision doc, self-merge pending on an unrelated CI blocker in artifacts/records-request-worker.
notDone: No gcloud delete/deploy/redeploy, no code edit, no commit, and no destructive command of any kind was run in this checkout or against the real GCP project. All gcloud calls were describe/list only. The recommendation to retire node-facet-bake-tier2 and the recommendation to run node-facet-patch-cad-roll for the 6 affected counties both require an explicit operator go-ahead before any action is taken -- neither was actioned here. Not independently verified: (1) whether hauska-factory's scripts/build-publish-bake-clis.mjs pipeline is itself live/scheduled -- different lane's checkout, out of scope to chase into; (2) the possibility of a human operator manually running node-facet-bake-tier2 from a terminal on an untracked private cadence -- every checkable channel (CI workflows, GCP Cloud Scheduler, GCP Cloud Run Jobs, doc_repo runbooks/_inbox) came back clean or unrelated, but absence of a tracked artifact is not absolute proof of absence for a manual habit.
